_note: 캐릭터 dps 13프레임 = 6셀 시트 A(idle·walk2·attack2·special) + B(dash4·hurt·death) + 단독 C(invuln). 프레임 이름은 SpriteBank.JOB_FRAMES 규격 그대로 — 어긋나면 조용히 누락된다.

rulesets.c6: Match the REFERENCE IMAGE EXACTLY: the SAME hooded rogue — dark charcoal hood and cloak, dusty-rose scarf at the neck, black leather armor with gold buckles, a single short steel sword in one hand. Reproduce the reference's hand-drawn pixel-art style precisely: same dot size, thin dark outlines, soft cel shading, same body proportions (stocky heroic chibi), same palette. THREE-QUARTER FRONT view at eye level, the FULL BODY standing, both feet visible on the ground. Not photorealistic, not 3D-rendered, no smooth gradients. LAYOUT: EXACTLY SIX CELLS TOTAL — a 3-column by 2-row grid (3 across, 2 down). Do not draw seven, eight, or nine cells. Exactly 3 columns and exactly 2 rows with clear empty pure-magenta gaps between the cells. The SAME knight, SAME scale, SAME camera angle in every cell, feet resting on a common baseline. The six poses MUST differ dramatically so motion is obvious when flipped through. Follow each cell's description literally. ABSOLUTELY NO TEXT ANYWHERE IN THE IMAGE — no captions, no frame numbers, no state names, no letters, no digits, no watermark, no grid lines, no borders. Only the character art on the magenta field. COLOR: full color, matching the reference palette. Background: flat solid pure magenta #FF00FF everywhere, NO SHADOW OF ANY KIND — no drop shadow, no ellipse or blob under the feet, no contact shadow. The magenta must be perfectly flat and uniform right up to the character's outline. No ground, no scenery.
rulesets.c1: Match the REFERENCE IMAGE EXACTLY: the SAME hooded rogue — dark charcoal hood, rose scarf, black leather armor with gold trim, short sword. Same hand-drawn pixel-art style, dot size, outlines, cel shading, proportions and palette as the reference. THREE-QUARTER FRONT view, full body standing, feet on the ground. Not photorealistic, not 3D. A SINGLE centered figure, no grid. No labels, no text. Background: flat solid pure magenta #FF00FF everywhere.
